attributes.name: Pre-condition
attributes.definition: A factual or legal requirement that must be met before a legal provision can be applied or any legal consequences can take effect.
includes: Full sentences including connecting words ('and', 'or') and punctuation (except full stops)

attributes.name: Post-condition
attributes.definition: A legal consequence resulting from the relevant pre-conditions being met.
includes: Legal consequence taking form of classification or behavior

attributes.name: Actor
attributes.definition: A natural person, legal entity, organisation, or body.
includes: Actors whose legal capacity enables the legal consequence
Essential non-acting actors directly necessary for the legal consequence
excludes: Mere mentions of an actor not necessary for the consequence

attributes.name: Legal Relation
attributes.definition: Legal elements linking two or more different actors (e.g., employment, corporate, family, contractual, public law).
includes: Relations between actors that are a necessary condition for the legal consequence

attributes.name: Act
attributes.definition: An action that must or may occur (positive act) or must not occur (negative act, inaction, failure to act) before legal consequences take effect.

attributes.name: Geographical / Physical Domain
attributes.definition: An identified establishment or specific geographical and physical domain where pre-conditional attributes must occur.
excludes: Entities capable of taking legal measures (Actors)

attributes.name: Temporal
attributes.definition: A specified or general period that should be considered before legal consequences are triggered.
excludes: Elements that chronologically precede but are not necessary conditions for the legal consequence

attributes.name: Explicit Reference
attributes.definition: A reference to a concept identified and defined within the same or another legal document.
includes: References to Regulations, Directives, Case Law, Articles, Annexes
excludes: References that are not pre-conditional attributes

attributes.name: Hierarchy
attributes.definition: The prioritisation of legal rules or other norms within a legal framework.
includes: The entire hierarchy as one text chunk

attributes.name: Residual Pre-condition
attributes.definition: Pre-conditional attributes that are conditional for legal consequences but do not fall under Actors, Legal Relations, Acts, Domains, Temporal, References, or Hierarchies.
includes: Necessary conditions that do not fit other categories
excludes: Any attribute that falls under Tasks 1-8

general_extraction_rules: Label attributes in the form of pronouns every time they appear.
Label 'and' and 'or' when they appear to avoid unnecessary merging.
Do not include punctuation unless necessary to avoid breaking an annotation into multiple parts.
For each extracted attribute, output a distinct Markdown file.
In the Markdown file, use Obsidian wiki-links (e.g., [[Attribute Text]]) to represent relationships with other entities.
